args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

Docstring already specified banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, so 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of
2.66, breaking tests/test_money.py in the nightly build.

args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though the docstring and FIN-212 specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), so `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`, failing the nightly build's `tests/test_money.py`.
- Fixed the implementation to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.
